subject.statement: Bernard Tapie a été condamné dans l'affaire VA-OM.

summary: Bernard Tapie was convicted in 1995 for his role in the VA-OM match-fixing scandal, receiving a suspended prison sentence and a fine. This conviction stands as a matter of record, so the statement that he was condemned in the VA-OM affair is accurate.
